steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each charter element is matched against the required list. A missing element is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Success measure with no target
findings.fix: Set a target the project can be closed against

findings.title: Scope item both in and out
findings.fix: Decide whether the item is in scope

outcome.notChecked: Whether the project should be done.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] charter-success.md:12  Success measure with no target.
       Fix: Set a target the project can be closed against.
[medium] charter-scope.md:19  Scope item both in and out.
       Fix: Decide whether the item is in scope.
[low] charter-constraints.md:26  Constraints element missing.
       Fix: Add the constraints.
Not checked: Whether the project should be done.
pros: Checks a missing element, a success measure with no target, and a scope item that is both in and out.
cons: Not checked: Whether the project should be done.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-pm-project-charter skill on the records for this review.
